evidence: The body checks an enable byte at object+0x47f, validates the incoming selector, then reads context selector values and uses unresolved helpers to produce an integer result. The helper result and business meaning are not established by this body. decompiled/main/main_0094.c:7395-7436; callers decompiled/main/main_0100.c:16753 and 16843.

Requires non-null input and enabled byte at object+0x428; obtains player attribute values for IDs 0x1e, 0x40, and 0x16 through player_attribute_get_float. It forms the numerator from IDs 0x1e+0x40 and denominator from 0x16+0x40, returns -2 if the denominator is below 1, and classifies the ratio into codes 0..5 using thresholds 0.2, 0.25, 0.4, 0.45, and 0.5. decompiled/main/main_0116.c:20282-20371; caller decompiled/main/main_0113.c:4886.

The body validates a record discriminator at +0x10, remaps selected secondary values, and invokes process_attribute_context_status only on some branches, but the overall record/event meaning and primary tail-call behavior are unresolved. decompiled/main/main_0053.c:5525-5582. No indexed caller was available.

The body reads context status selector 0, dispatches through a static lookup table, then checks selector 0x13 and conditionally calls several unresolved side-effect helpers before returning a small code. These operations do not establish a precise behavior label. decompiled/main/main_0119.c:5036-5152; caller decompiled/main/main_0118.c:3591.

Calls ranked_record_0x30_reset ten times per iteration across two loops of twenty iterations, resetting 400 ranked-record slots total. Each reset is spaced by 0x30 bytes in the repeated sequences. decompiled/main/main_0169.c:51921-51956 and 51962-51985; caller decompiled/main/main_0050.c:6022.
